summary: Why FindEntity 00898E30 answered nil for all 38 of usn_2_java's calls even though both halves of the binding were already complete: the thisTable slot it pushes is built by entity virtual slot 39, the only caller of that slot is BSP_SEntity_InitAll 00925F20 at 0092604E, and that pass runs for every pending entity rather than only for units. Wiring it, plus two corrections (GetMeasure pushes the text key, and a slot's `ID` is a string), carries the mission script from a raise at usn_2_java.lua:563 to 2500 frames of phase 2 with no script failure at all.

coverage.note: Five passes over the pending list at [00F899D0] plus the tail, 00925F20..0092638A. The SEH frame and the one-time NativeString label init at 00925F5F..00925F99 are not modelled; the progress arithmetic, the three vtable passes, pass C's start-enabled branch, pass D's session gate and pass E's descriptor release are.

The eleven classes whose creator stores a vtable with an attach at +9Ch, read from the shipped image. The fifteen UnitClassFactory and TypedResource creators install their vtable deeper than a one-call-deep immediate scan reaches and have no row; they are the unit classes the executable's unit host already owns. world_kind is unread for LandingPoint, SimpleEffect and PeriodicEffect.

Both arms. Contract corrected: the binding pushes the text key itself.

Named by slot. The two virtuals passes B and C call after the attach; no concrete body was read for either.

Wired, not re-read. src/lua_binding_core.cpp already carried it. The two entity virtuals it dispatches through (+5Ch at 008A8A83, +2Ch at 008A8AE3) still have no resolved concrete vtable and stay contract: unread; the executable reports both and takes the no-session-message arm by choice.
Wired, not re-read. src/recon_values.cpp already carried it.
The nineteen category maps stay empty. Filling them needs the recon slot lists of docs/RECON_SLOT_LISTS.md.

run_time_evidence.before: The same command before this packet: 29 x "script call luaTimetable failed: usn_2_java.lua:563: ***ERROR: luaGetDistance's second param is a non-table parameter", Mission.EscapePoint nil, FindEntity 00898e30 UNIMPLEMENTED calls=38.
intermediate: markers wired, GetMeasure still wrong: 29 x usn_2_java.lua:565 "bad argument #2 to 'format' (number expected, got nil)", because luaMetric compares GetMeasure() against the key literals.

GetMeasure fixed, ID still a number: 29 x commandhelpers.lua:12343 "attempt to index global 'recon' (a nil value)", traceback luaGetOwnUnits <- luaInitMissionEnd <- luaMissionCompletedNew <- luaMissionComplete (usn_2_java.lua:817) <- usn_2_java.lua:593. luaMissionComplete ran at mission frame 793 on a false zero distance: thisTable[Obj.ID] missed with a number key, so GetPosition answered the origin for both arguments.
run_time_evidence.long_run: --frames 12300 --mission-frames 12000 (600 simulated seconds) reaches the same state with no failure and Mission.Distance 8.77 km: Houston keeps its authored Cruise command and sails away from EscapePoint, so the phase-2 completion test is gated on whatever drives the controlled unit, not on the Lua layer.

corrections.was: include/bsp/lua_binding_mission.hpp: GetMeasure's two arms "push the value at a dotted globals path, through 00B672B0, so the binding answers the localised unit name the globals table carries, not a literal of its own".
corrections.is: 00B672B0 pushes the string it is given. Its only callees are 00A672F0 lua_checkstack and 00A67A10 lua_pushlstring; the empty literal at 0108FF2C stands in for a null data pointer at 00B672CD. GetMeasure answers the text key "globals.kilometer" or "globals.mile".
corrections.evidence: 00B672B0..00B672E2 in full, and usn_2_java.lua:923 luaMetric comparing GetMeasure() against those two literals. With the old contract luaMetric returned nil and the run raised at usn_2_java.lua:565.

corrections.was: src/game_hosts_lua.cpp milestone 2l: a thisTable slot's `ID` is lua_pushnumber(entity id).
corrections.is: `ID` is the key text. 00928BA5 hands 00B67630 the NativeString the decimal key was formatted into, and 00B67630's value push at 00B6766A is lua_pushlstring.
corrections.evidence: 00928B9B..00928BA5 and 00B67630..00B67677. docs/MISSION_LUA_SELF_TABLE.md line 93 already recorded it. The consequence was silent: every shipped helper indexes thisTable[Obj.ID], a number key never matched the string key, luaGetDistance3D compared two all-zero positions, and the 2500-frame run before the fix reported luaMissionComplete at mission frame 793 on a distance of zero.

corrections.was: src/game_hosts_lua.cpp milestone 2l: one scene-entity list feeds both the thisTable slots and the FindEntity name index.
corrections.is: They are different sets. Slot 39 is called on every pending entity, with no class filter, and 0088B1B0 walks 14 of 97 world buckets, so MovieCamPos and MovieCamLookat have a slot and are not findable by name.
corrections.evidence: 0092604E has no preceding class test in 00925F20's first pass; the bucket table of docs/LUA_BINDING_ENTITY_LOOKUP.md.

corrections.was: src/game_hosts_script_orders.cpp: SetParty 008A8930 is a record, so it returns nothing.
corrections.is: It returns the party number it was given, and usn_2_java.lua:54 stores that in Mission.Party, which no shipped script assigns anywhere else. The already reconstructed bsp::lua_binding_set_party is now routed the row.
corrections.evidence: 008A8AE9 pushes on both arms after the branch rejoins (docs/LUA_BINDING_CORE.md). Run: Party=0, and recon[Mission.Party].own then resolves to the nineteen category maps (recon_own_categories=19). With Party nil the recon shell alone would not have closed the mission-end gate.

corrections.is: That is the direct-call graph. 00928A00 is also entered as entity virtual slot 39 from 0092604E, which is the only route for the classes that install the base implementation unchanged.
corrections.evidence: 0092604E MOV EAX,[EDX+0x9c] / 00926054 CALL EAX in 00925F20, and the dword at 00CE85EC. The ledger evidence is appended, not replaced.

follow_ups.why: The nineteen category maps of the recon shell are empty. Filling them needs the recon slot lists, a subsystem this packet did not enter; until then a script that asks which units it can see gets an empty list, which is a wrong answer rather than an error.
The two entity virtuals passes B and C call after the attach, and the session registration pass D makes. All three are named by slot or address with no body read.

usn_2_java's phase-2 primary objective completes when Houston comes within 500 m of EscapePoint, and Houston is the unit SetSelectedUnit hands the player. Headless it keeps its authored Cruise command and the distance grows. No Lua-layer gate remains.
Still open from docs/LUA_BINDING_MISSION.md. GetHpPercentage answers 0, so phase 1 closes on a false positive. 00923BF1 is the one virtual call site of the unit vtable +110h in the whole image.

Already follow-up of docs/LUA_BINDING_CORE.md and now on a path the executable runs: SetParty's two entity virtuals have no resolved concrete vtable, so the executable reports both and no party is written to any entity.
LandingPoint, SimpleEffect and PeriodicEffect carry an attach at +9Ch and their world bucket was not read, so whether FindEntity can name one is open.
